snippet.title: Jumpy
snippet.description:
Our latest pixel hero is introduced to Android devices! Running in a retro pixel mode, Jumpy is a tribute to all the classic stuff from great games like Mario and Sonic.

Read more about the game here: http://www.orangepixel.net/jumpy/
